title: Spotify interim report for the six months ended June 30, 2026
excerpt: June 30 liquidity was EUR 9.388 billion; 210.241 million shares were issued and 4.657 million were held in treasury.
summary: The current SEC filing supplies IFRS financial statements, cash and investments, share count, repurchases, commitments and risks needed to normalize the Q2 assessment and valuation.
